blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Environment officials in North Cotabato province released an adult Philippine serpent eagle (Spilornis holospilus) into the wild on Tuesday after receiving medical clearance from local authorities. Maria Elvira Lumayag, regional executive director of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Region 12 (DENR-12), said the raptor was first rescued on Nov.
